PC: Obtains focused history and physical exam, particularly focusing on stroke mimics, indications/contraindications for ivTPA, and the neurologic exam
Obtain large-bore IV access and continuous cardiac monitoring
Orders other appropriate diagnostic and laboratory evaluation including EKG, CBC, basic metabolic panel, INR, aptt
On return from CT scanner, recognizes and treats significant hypertension
MK: Recognizes likely diagnosis of CVA and obtains STAT HCT
SBP: Coordinate final disposition for the patient and admit to ICU
ICS: Discuss with the patient the risks and benefits of IV tPA
Obtain informed consent for ivTPA administration
